text: Figure 3.20: CppImplementationDataType overview [TPS_MANI_01309] Semantics of attribute CppImplementationDataType. headerFile ⌈The attribute CppImplementationDataType.headerFile shall be used to specify the name of the corresponding header file in two cases: • A CustomCppImplementationDataType shall set the value of the attribute to the name of the header file that defines the C++ code for the CustomCppIm- plementationDataType. • A platform data type (modeled as a StdCppImplementationDataType) shall set the attribute to the name of the applicable header file (e.g. “cstdint”) from the C++ standard library . ⌋ [constr_1743] CppImplementationDataType.headerFile vs. CppImplemen- tationDataType.typeEmitter Imposition time: IT_BefAraApiGen ⌈The two attributes CppImplementationDataType.headerFile and CppImple- mentationDataType.typeEmitter shall always be used mutually exclusive.
